description: D37 — 双车分驻两条开放列

intro.popup_en: Connecting the Rooks, Lesson 2: After connecting them, assign the rooks to the two most important open files. White will use Rfe1 on the e-file and Rad1 on the d-file.
intro.popup:
链接双车第2课
连接之后，分驻两条最重要的开放列
看白方如何让Rfe1控e列、Rad1控d列！

outro.popup_en: Rfe1 controls the e-file and Rad1 the d-file. White's rooks occupy the two central files, a classic example of bringing both rooks into the game quickly.
outro.popup:
总结：Rfe1（e列），Rad1（d列）
白方双车分占中心两列
这是双车快速加入战斗的一个经典范例！

moves.popup_en: d4 controls the center. White plans to support it with c4 in the Queen's Gambit.
moves.popup:
d4控制中心
计划：d4+c4后翼兵对

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks d5.
moves.popup:
Nf6黑方马出动
攻击d5格

moves.popup_en: c4! The Queen's Gambit contests d5 and fights for the center.
moves.popup:
c4！后翼弃兵
计划：控制d5，争夺中心

moves.popup_en: ...e6 supports Black's center and prepares either ...dxc4 or ...d5.
moves.popup:
e6黑方防御
准备dxc4或d5

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops, supports d4, and controls d5.
moves.popup:
Nc3马出动
协调：支援d4+控制d5

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black challenges the center in the Queen's Gambit Declined.
moves.popup:
d5！黑方挑战中心
后翼弃兵防御

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops and controls e5 and d4. The minor pieces are still being developed before the rooks are connected.
moves.popup:
Nf3！马出动
激活：Nf3控e5和d4
连接进度：轻子出动中…

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops and prepares castling.
moves.popup:
Be7黑方象出动
准备易位

moves.popup_en: Bf4! White develops the c1-bishop along the c1-h6 diagonal. Together with Nf3, it reinforces control of e5.
moves.popup:
Bf4！象出动
激活：c1象控c1-h6斜线
协调：Bf4+Nf3联合控e5

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.
moves.popup:
O-O黑方易位
黑方王安全

moves.popup_en: e3 stabilizes White's center and prepares Be2.
moves.popup:
e3稳固中心
为Be2做准备

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops Black's second knight and prepares the ...c5 counterbreak.
moves.popup:
Nbd7黑方第2马出动
准备c5反击

moves.popup_en: Be2! White develops the final minor piece. All minor pieces are ready; after castling, White can connect the rooks.
moves.popup:
Be2！象出动
连接进度：轻子全部出动！
计划：易位后连接双车

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black counterattacks and challenges White's c4-pawn.
moves.popup:
c5！黑方反击
挑战白方c4兵

moves.popup_en: O-O! White completes castling and activates the rook on f1. The second step is complete; next clear the back rank and assign the rooks.
moves.popup:
O-O！易位完成！
激活：Rf1进入游戏
连接进度：三步曲第二步✅
计划：现在清空底线，然后分配双车！

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 exchanges pawns and opens the c-file.
moves.popup:
cxd4黑方兑换
打开c列

moves.popup_en: exd4 recaptures. Both the e- and d-files are now semi-open, providing a natural file for each rook.
moves.popup:
exd4重吃
激活：e列和d列同时半开放！
关键：两列开放，正好给双车各一条列！

moves.popup_en: ...dxc4 captures the c4-pawn and opens both the c- and d-files further.
moves.popup:
dxc4黑方吃c4兵
c列和d列全面开放

moves.popup_en: Bxc4 recaptures and reactivates the bishop.
moves.popup:
Bxc4象吃回
激活：象重新激活

moves.popup_en: ...Nb6 develops to an active square and attacks the bishop on c4.
moves.popup:
Nb6黑马跳强格
攻击c4象

moves.popup_en: Bb3 retreats and preserves the bishop.
moves.popup:
Bb3象后退
保存象的活力

moves.popup_en: ...Bd7 develops and prevents Bg5.
moves.popup:
Bd7黑方象出动
防止Bg5

moves.popup_en: Qd3! The queen supports d4 and coordinates the rooks. Queen and rooks work together to control the center.
moves.popup:
Qd3！后出动
激活：后来到d3
协调：Qd3支援d4，联结双车
计划：后+双车三位一体控制中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd5 occupies a strong central square and seeks queenside counterplay.
moves.popup:
Nbd5黑马占中心强格
黑方后翼反击

moves.popup_en: Rfe1! The rook from f1 occupies the e-file and watches Black's rook on e8. The first assignment is clear: Re1 controls the e-file.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！车进e列！
激活：Rf1移到e1
协调：Re1控制e列，监视Re8
双车分工开始：Re1负责e列！

moves.popup_en: ...Re8 contests the e-file with Black's rook.
moves.popup:
Re8黑方车进e列
争夺e列

moves.popup_en: Rad1!! The rook from a1 takes the d-file. White's rooks now have distinct jobs: Rfe1 guards the e-file and Rad1 the d-file, coordinated with Qd3 to dominate the center.
moves.popup:
Rad1！！双车协调完成！
激活：Ra1进入d列！
✅ 双车分工完成：
♖ Rfe1 = e列守护者
♖ Rad1 = d列守护者
Qd3+Rad1+Rfe1 = 中心完全统治！
这是双车协作的教科书形态！
